entities.summary: Jordina Salabert, better known by her stage name, Jil Love, is an artist and activist (artivist) whose work features public performance art and demonstration to create public awareness of human rights, the environment, animal rights, and LGBT rights. Her work involves performance art and artistic passive resistance in public spaces using the human body, sometimes using nudity.
